content:
mike: Heads up — several gpu-pool deploys are failing after the RBAC refactor ~10m ago. Controller shows 403 on KMS decrypt when trying to unwrap projected SA tokens. :warning:

jia: I landed the role/rolebinding split earlier to enforce least-priv, didn't touch cluster KMS role bindings though. which controller is hitting 403?

mike: deploy-controller in `infra` ns. logs:
```
W 10:12:03.123 deploy-controller: failed to decrypt token: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = request for projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/...: permission denied
status: 403
```

mike: `kubectl -n infra get rolebinding | grep kms` returns nothing for deploy-controller-sa. looks like the new role-slim policy removed the clusterrolebinding that granted the controller the KMS decrypt permission.

olivia: I temporarily added `nodepool-sa` to the old `kms-decrypt-clusterrolebinding` to unbreak jobs, but that broadens privileges — we should not keep it. :lock:

mike: don't widen scope. propose: (1) add back a namespaced RoleBinding that grants only `cryptoKeys.decrypt` via the kms-adapter ServiceAccount on the deploy-controller pod; (2) revert the global clusterrolebinding change; (3) add an automated audit rule to detect future missing kms bindings.

jia: ack. my change was intended to remove implicit cluster-level grants, but looks like deploy-controller relies on cluster-scoped binding in a way I missed. I'll prepare a minimal Role + RoleBinding and roll it out to infra only.

sre-liz: I'll apply a hotfix in the next 5m and roll it back if anything weird. runbook steps I'm following:
1) patch with namespaced rolebinding:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: deploy-kms-decrypt
  namespace: infra
rules:
- apiGroups: ["kms.corp"]
  resources: ["keydecrypt"]
  verbs: ["use"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: deploy-kms-decrypt-binding
  namespace: infra
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: deploy-controller-sa
  namespace: infra
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: deploy-kms-decrypt
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
2) confirm decrypt logs and resume queued gpu jobs
3) create alert rule for >3 decrypt 403s in 10m for any controller

security-bot: Incident created: INC-20260320-42 (severity: high) — assigned to eng-security and eng-sre. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-20260320-42

raj: Also add an audit-log gcloud query to the runbook so SRE can search for previous decrypt denies and confirm scope of exposure. Example:
`gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt" AND severity=ERROR' --limit=100`

mike: great. after hotfix, let's run an org-wide RBAC smoke test for all controllers that project tokens. add test to CI. :thumbsup:

jia: will follow up with a PR that re-applies least-priv but keeps a safely-scoped namespaced binding for controllers that need kms decrypt.

olivia: created a temporary policy exception ticket to track the narrow escalation while we fix the bindings: TICKET-SEC-547. will close after rollback.

sre-liz: hotfix applied, decrypt 403s dropped to 0 in infra logs, resuming jobs. will open PR with the Role/RoleBinding manifest and runbook changes.

mike: thanks team — good catch and quick rollback. keep the audit queries and CI test on the TODO list.
